title: Luis Jiménez Aranda, Capturing Everyday Life
content: Luis Jiménez y Aranda(Edit: and his brother Jose) (1845–1928) painted moments from ordinary life in Spain.JoseJiménez y ArandaThe Bibliophiles, 1879Here he shows book lovers from various walks of life surveying the wares. To paint scenes like this, he used models, and he would have set up the actual costumes on lay figures.Luis Jiménez y Aranda, The Artist's StudioHere he paints of an artist's studio, showing the artist with his palette standing behind a wealthy patron, as a model lounges in a festive pose on the far right.JoseJiménez y Aranda, Self PortraitLuis Jiménez y Arandawas part of a worldwide artistic movement using realism to capture the detail of everyday life.-----Previously on GJ:Costumbrism
